ev.q: DOOM Eternal is the best FPS of all time
Experience the ultimate combination of speed and power
The fast-paced movement, weak points, ammo scarcity
is much more rapid, and is more likely to fill half of your screen
Take what you need from your enemies
The fast-paced movement, weak points, ammo scarcity
Every enemy has weaknesses, and learning how to exploit them makes combat satisfying
I love how demanding the combat is
the soundtrack hypes you up in the background
Definitely gets repetitive after a while
every single room has a bunch of infinitely respawning trash mobs
Instead of an aggressive shooter, it plays like a rigid rhythm-puzzle game
The game is just pure gameplay
